# Playbooks (exact text from P2_Playbooks; auto-generated, do not edit)

## PB-1 - Performance deep-dive
- **What happens:** Joint call with merchant and Payments Ops to review success-rate drop by method/bank; share fix plan within 3 days.
- **When it applies:** Success rate fell sharply or merchant complains of failures

## PB-2 - Support recovery
- **What happens:** CSM takes ownership of all open tickets, gives a single point of contact and a closure date; senior callback within 48 hours.
- **When it applies:** Multiple unresolved tickets, low CSAT

## PB-3 - Commercial review
- **What happens:** Account Manager reviews rate card, volume tiers and renewal terms before the renewal date.
- **When it applies:** Competitor mention, renewal within ~60 days

## PB-4 - Re-engagement and adoption
- **What happens:** Executive-sponsor outreach plus a short workshop on unused products and reports; re-confirm the right contact person.
- **When it applies:** Low logins, few products used, no response to outreach

## PB-5 - Growth / expansion check-in
- **What happens:** Positive check-in; offer new products or higher-limit plans.
- **When it applies:** Healthy and growing

## PB-6 - Monitor only
- **What happens:** No outreach; keep on watchlist and re-check next month.
- **When it applies:** Seasonal dip, low-volume stable, or no real risk signal
